title: W9 re-pin left `stream_spawned` counting pre-surge ticks while MIN_LAND is window-only, padding the surge-lands assertion
detail: The re-pin gated the per-terminal counters (per_tick_host_burst, per_host_spawns) to `tick >= SURGE_START` but left the aggregate `stream_spawned` accumulating from tick 1; base spawns over ticks 1..1199 (~1/tick across the growing crowd) pad the count vs a window-only MIN_LAND, so a surge under-delivering by up to ~10% still passes the 'must LAND' pin.
recommended_fix: Move `stream_spawned += 1` inside the existing `if tick >= SURGE_START {` block so the aggregate matches the window-only MIN_LAND it is compared against.
